title: Flies.
description:
A house infested with rot. The smell of mold in the air. Why are you here? Who are you doing this for? Maybe with enough attempts you'll find the real answer. You just have to remember it. After all, you don't want to get swarmed by...

Flies.

...Right?

This game has and includes:

• Multiple endings!

• Wacky puzzles!

• Groovy atmosphere!

• Insane crafting! (combining two items...)

• Incredible inventory system!

• Fly kill-counter!

• A very rotten cozy house to explore!

• A terribly unhelpful protagonist.

• A grave you don't remember.

• ...

• ...

• Flies.

In this psychological horror game, try to discover secrets and remember more things to help you along your way. Try and combine unique items to create even more unique items, use those items to your advantage and get all 8 (9?) endings. Figure out puzzles and learn about the past and the future, all while trying to kill as many flies as possible. Possibly even getting rid of all the flies in this house, who knows?

Controls:

Game is controlled mainly with a mouse, movement is with keyboard. All menus can use mouse to navigate. Press 'Esc' to pause. Otherwise, all controls should be laid out on-screen.

Do not play this game if you have pteronarcophobia. That much should be obvious...
